pages.title: Googloid Eye
pages.text: Slay a Googloid (found on the little pink moons in Cyberland) and obtain a Googloid Eye.

pages.title: Getting in
pages.text: Use the eye on the retinal scanner block at the top of a very big moon.

pages.title: Be careful
pages.text: Mobs in the dungeon are strong, and the deeper you go the further you will have to go to escape. Many chests and spawners can be found.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: The most important item to get here is Rusty Moon Coins and Rust Remover, the coins drop from Moon Dungeon Guards and the Rust Remover is found in the chests.
